data.narrative:
Terrahaptix, a Series A defense and security frontier-tech company founded by Nathan Nwachukwu and Maxwell Maduka, has raised $34M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 8 private companies (including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI) and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer set ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods apply directly. Stage-progression anchors to the $34M total raised as a proxy valuation, applying a standard 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, yielding $68M. The peer-median method uses the median valuation across the 10-company comp set: $1.0B. This range reflects the wide dispersion typical of early-stage defense tech, with peer valuations spanning from Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B) down to lower-stage entrants.

Synthesizing both methods produces a valuation range of $58M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $534M. The wide band reflects genuine stage and maturity dispersion within the peer set and meaningful uncertainty around Terrahaptix's specific competitive positioning, customer traction, and technology differentiation relative to better-funded or later-stage peers. The peer-median method carries substantially more weight given the larger sample, though stage-progression serves as a reality-check floor.
